selection_protocol: After retaining the V3 generalisation failure, explicitly combined the bank plus exposed V2/V3 probes as development data. Compared six predefined category-mapping candidates. Selected category-manual among four perfect ties because it states the reviewed self-report/reverse-coding constraints explicitly. Froze it before running the 414-case V4 probes. No further prompt tuning follows that result in this round.

evaluations.derivation: The 718 bank cases are a subset of the 986-case development execution, not a second independent GPU run. Counts recomputed for the bank alone.

failure_note: The two failed cases share one canonical input: keyed N, selected N (displayed position 14 in a 20-option item). The assessment currently uses four-option MCQs. No post-probe special case or prompt repair is applied.

v4_probe_overlap.note: Novel fixture wording is not necessarily a new model input after nominal encoding. Compare canonical rows, not text labels or case counts.

limitations: Coding agreement is not literature-adjudicated psychological accuracy, construct validity, calibrated probability or a clinical diagnosis.
The original bank remains exposed and contains probable key/instrument defects documented separately. High agreement can reproduce those defects.
Nominal encoding is deterministic input representation, not model-derived psychological knowledge. The model still selects every point decision.
986 development cases compress to 48 distinct model inputs; 414 novel cases compress to 64. Neither case count is an independent sample size.
V4 is an adaptive follow-up to a failed V3 probe. Both rounds and denominators must be reported; do not present only the successful round as a preregistered external study.
Timings are single-browser observations after initialization. No general hardware performance or zero-wait guarantee is made.
Fine-tuning was not performed. Training requires lawful data, reviewed labels and independent validation; research submission remains disabled.
